say:1:1831107001:1.text: Ah! Excuse me, do you happen to know where the flower shop on Crescent Street is?
say:1:1831107001:1.source_cn: 啊，不好意思，请问你知道月弯街上的花店在哪里吗？
say:1:1831107001:1.male: Ah! Excuse me, do you happen to know where the flower shop on Crescent Street is?
say:1:1831107001:1.female: Ah! Excuse me, do you happen to know where the flower shop on Crescent Street is?

say:2:1831107002:1.text: I'm not a Grave—ahem, I mean, I'm not a local. My husband wrote to me with this address, so I'm not really sure how to get there...
say:2:1831107002:1.source_cn: 我不是亡……唔，我不是本地人。这个地址是我丈夫写信告诉...
say:2:1831107002:1.male: I'm not a Grave—ahem, I mean, I'm not a local. My husband wrote to me with this address, so I'm not really sure how to get there...
say:2:1831107002:1.female: I'm not a Grave—ahem, I mean, I'm not a local. My husband wrote to me with this address, so I'm not really sure how to get there...

say:3:1831107003:1.text: It's obvious this anxious woman is a stowaway, likely visiting family here in Novaris.
say:3:1831107003:1.source_cn: 很显然，眼前这位拘谨的女士是偷渡者，大概率是来诺珐斯探亲的。

choice_prompt:4:1831107003.text: It's obvious this anxious woman is a stowaway, likely visiting family here in Novaris.

say:5:1831107004:0.text: ... Thank you. I guess my disguise still needs some work.
say:5:1831107004:0.source_cn: ……谢谢。看来我的伪装还是有点差呀。
say:5:1831107004:0.male: ... Thank you. I guess my disguise still needs some work.
say:5:1831107004:0.female: ... Thank you. I guess my disguise still needs some work.

say:7:1831107005:0.text: You take the letter she hands you and check the details. However, a line catches your eye.
say:7:1831107005:0.source_cn: 你接过她递来的信纸，查看上面的详细地址。然而，无意间瞥...
say:7:1831107005:0.male: You take the letter she hands you and check the details. However, a line catches your eye.
say:7:1831107005:0.female: You take the letter she hands you and check the details. However, a line catches your eye.

say:8:1831107006:1.text: "Once you arrive, you'll know who was responsible for separating us."
say:8:1831107006:1.source_cn: ——“等你抵达那里，就会知道是谁造成了我们的分离”。

say:10:1831107007:0.text: Acting natural, you point out the location of the flower shop on Crescent Street. Maybe you should follow her and check it out yourself, just in case this stowaway catches the guards' eyes.
say:10:1831107007:0.source_cn: 你不动声色地为她指出了月弯街花店的位置。也许你也该过去...
say:10:1831107007:0.male: Acting natural, you point out the location of the flower shop on Crescent Street. Maybe you should follow her and check it out yourself, just in case this stowaway catches the guards' eyes.
say:10:1831107007:0.female: Acting natural, you point out the location of the flower shop on Crescent Street. Maybe you should follow her and check it out yourself, just in case this stowaway catches the guards' eyes.

choice:4:1:2.text: I won't report you, don't worry.
choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 我不会举报你是偷渡者的
choice:4:1:2.male: I won't report you, don't worry.
choice:4:1:2.female: I won't report you, don't worry.
